author: ezpz-content
instruction_bn: বাক্যটিকে Indirect Speech-এ রূপান্তর করো (Board: narrative style, 7 marks)।

a: He said that he was busy then.

items.original: She said to me, "I will help you."
a: She told me that she would help me.

items.original: He said, "I went to school yesterday."
a: He said that he had gone to school the previous day.
He said that he had gone to school the day before.
items.rule_bn: past→past perfect (went→had gone), yesterday→the previous day।

items.original: The teacher said, "The earth is round."
a: The teacher said that the earth is round.
items.rule_bn: চিরন্তন সত্য হলে tense পরিবর্তন হয় না: is অপরিবর্তিত।

items.original: He asked me, "Where do you live?"
a: He asked me where I lived.
items.rule_bn: Wh-প্রশ্নে: asked + Wh-word, tag বাদ, do you live→I lived।

items.original: She said to him, "Are you happy?"
a: She asked him if he was happy.
She asked him whether he was happy.
items.rule_bn: Yes/No প্রশ্নে 'if/whether' বসে; are you→he was।

items.original: He said to me, "Please help me."
a: He requested me to help him.
items.rule_bn: অনুরোধে: requested + to + base verb; please বাদ।

items.original: The teacher said, "Do not make a noise."
a: The teacher forbade the students to make a noise.
The teacher ordered the students not to make a noise.
items.rule_bn: নিষেধে: forbade + to / ordered ... not to।

items.original: He said, "What a nice bird it is!"
a: He exclaimed with joy that it was a very nice bird.
items.rule_bn: Exclamatory: exclaimed with joy that; what a nice→a very nice।
